name: totp-rfc6238
description: External TOTP provider: implements totp@1 with RFC 4226 (HOTP) + RFC 6238 (TOTP) on node:crypto HMAC-SHA1/256/512 - named entries with a base32 key, current 6-digit code

config.description: No `entries` is a valid state: the plugin then loads and reports 'not configured' without registering the provider.

entries.description: One entry per name/label: { secret? | credential?, issuer?, account?, digits?, period?, algorithm? }. `secret` is a base32 key (a `${cred:NAME}` reference here is expanded by the core before apply, the preferred form); `credential` is a credential NAME resolved at CALL time through ctx.credentials, never a value. An entry with neither, or whose credential does not resolve, is reported as configured:false and fails only when it is used.
